The post Google Accelerates Chrome Updates to Outrun Fast-Moving AI Hackers appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: Google has announced it will accelerate the release schedule for its Chrome browser, moving from a four-week update cycle to a new two-week cadence. The change is designed to help outrun fast-moving hackers utilizing artificial intelligence. The updated release schedule began with the launch of Chrome 153 across desktop, Android, and iOS platforms, with subsequent stable releases planned to follow every two weeks.
